Your action plan

Choose one goal to build a plan.

Four practical steps

  1. Check your business name, location, website, credentials and service information.
  2. Explain the client types you serve, your service scope, secure contact options and seasonal availability.
  3. Create one general preparation guide without asking people to upload tax documents or account details publicly.
  4. Track listing interest separately from engagements, filings and revenue.

Keep these rules in mind

  • Do not give individualized tax or financial advice through public tools.
  • Do not collect sensitive documents or account information publicly.
  • Do not guarantee savings, filings or outcomes.
